landing.badge: Built for work, study, friends, and every shared plan
landing.headline: A shared whiteboard for teamwork.
landing.description: Claro helps teams, study groups, friends, and creators explain ideas, draw diagrams, split tasks, and keep the whole group moving together.
landing.footerDescription: A collaborative whiteboard for teams, study groups, friends, and creators to brainstorm, organize ideas, and work together in real time on learning, planning, and projects.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything your group needs to think visually
landing.featuresDescription: Use Claro to turn scattered conversations into a shared workspace for ideas, tasks, notes, and diagrams.
landing.aboutTitle: A clearer place for shared work
landing.aboutDescription: Claro gives groups one visual space where everyone can understand the plan, contribute ideas, and keep context together.
landing.feature1Text: Work on one board while everyone in the group sees ideas, notes, and sketches appear in real time.
landing.feature2Text: Plan roles, collect references, map concepts, and turn any group idea into a clear shared plan.
landing.feature3Text: A lightweight interface keeps drawing, moving, and editing smooth when the conversation is moving fast.
landing.feature4Text: Sketch workflows, study notes, timelines, mind maps, and examples so everyone can understand the topic together.
landing.feature5Text: Simple controls help teammates, study groups, friends, and clients join by code without extra setup.
landing.feature6Text: Keep sketches, short explanations, and task ideas in one tidy place instead of losing them in chats.
landing.feature7Text: Use the board for brainstorming, work planning, study sessions, presentation prep, and quick summaries.
landing.feature8Text: Designed for people in the same room, at home, at work, or split across different groups.
landing.point1Text: Claro was created so teams, study groups, friends, and creators can work visually instead of scattering ideas across chats, calls, and separate notes.
landing.point2Text: People can collect ideas, explain tricky topics, assign parts of a project, and keep everyone aligned on one shared board.
landing.point3Text: When people draw, react, and improve ideas together, collaboration becomes active. Shared context helps the group understand faster and move forward.

home.homeTitle: Ready for your next shared board?
home.homeDescription: A calm space for work, study, friends, and creative plans. Enter a room code to join your group board, or start a new one in one click.
home.joinBoardDescription: Use the code someone shared with you, or any board ID you have used before.
